description: Aren's Shield Crest (아렌의 방패 문장): an old round steel shield boss, dented and scratched, with a strip of ash-grey cloth tied through it (no emblem, no letters).
The Teacher's Tome (스승의 마도서): a worn leather-bound spellbook with brass corners, a faint violet glow leaking between the pages.
Garr's Iron Ring (가르의 쇠가락지): a thick, crude iron ring with a scratched surface, resting on a scrap of red cloth.
The Runner's Map Case (도주 대장의 지도통): a leather map tube with a shoulder strap, a rolled map peeking out of the open end.
The Pursuer's Greaves (추격 지휘관의 각반): a pair of leather-and-iron greaves splashed with dried mud.
The Quartermaster's Seal (병참관의 인장): a small brass seal stamp with a dark wooden handle, its stamp face plain and blank.
